Name: Hack Night
description: An open evening for students to build projects, meet teammates, and get help from mentors. Pizza is provided while supplies last.

Name: Science Week Kickoff
description: Kick off Science Week with student booths, games, music, and snacks.

Name: Engineering Design Team Showcase
description: Meet UBC engineering design teams and learn how to join their upcoming projects and competitions.

Name: Commerce Coffee Chat
description: A casual networking event connecting students with alumni working in finance, marketing, and consulting.

Name: Outdoor Yoga Session
description: A beginner-friendly outdoor yoga session. Participants should bring a mat and water.

Name: Forest Futures Panel
description: Faculty and industry guests discuss sustainable forestry, conservation, and career pathways.

Name: Food Systems Community Dinner
club: UBC Land and Food Systems Undergraduate Society
description: A community dinner featuring locally sourced dishes and conversation about sustainable food systems.

Name: Biology Research Mixer
description: Connect with biology researchers and students to hear about laboratory and field research opportunities.

Name: Chemistry Trivia Night
description: Team-based chemistry and general science trivia with prizes for the top teams.

Name: Stargazing and Telescope Night
description: Observe planets and deep-sky objects through student-operated telescopes, weather permitting.
